step_1_is_0.18_a_legal_carve_value.result: 0.18 = exactly 3 Carve stacks — a legal value for ONE Carve debuff in isolation. The value itself is not arithmetically wrong.

step_2_is_factor_1.11_self_consistent.result: The pair (0.18, 1.11) is internally consistent against a ~120–125-armor target. The removal therefore cannot be justified as an arithmetic-error fix; it must be justified (or refuted) on attribution/stacking grounds.

step_3_the_decisive_rule.premise_a: Carve is a UNIQUE NAMED effect that produces a single debuff on the TARGET, hard-capped at 5 stacks = 30% [S1, S8, S9].
step_3_the_decisive_rule.premise_b: Percent armor reductions from distinct sources compose as r1 + r2 − r1·r2 [S7], matching the engine's running-value composition [S4].
step_3_the_decisive_rule.premise_c: A 'support_resistance_reduction' bucket exists alongside the attacker's own reduction path (the engine composes ally-side reductions on top of attacker-side ones — coupled participant timeline).
step_3_the_decisive_rule.premise_d: In this scenario the ally item named in the scenario id is Bloodsong, whose cached effect contains NO resistance reduction at all — only an 8%/5% damage-taken amplifier [S2]. The only cached source of 'armor_reduction_percent' from any item is Black Cleaver itself [S3].
step_3_the_decisive_rule.arithmetic: If the same Carve is counted once on the attacker path and again in the support bucket: 0.18 + 0.18 − 0.18·0.18 = 0.3276 = 32.76% armor reduction — produced by only 3 stacks, and strictly greater than Carve's documented ABSOLUTE maximum of 30% at 5 stacks [S1]. That is unreachable under the item's own text, so a second, independently-composing Carve term is impossible.
step_3_the_decisive_rule.rule_precedent: The codebase's own foundations already encode the shared-debuff rule for the analogous case: Grievous Wounds 'sources do not stack' / strongest-wins [S6]. A named unique debuff is counted once per target, never once per holder.
step_3_the_decisive_rule.conclusion: Whatever composes with it, a second 'Black Cleaver — Carve' term — or an attacker-owned Carve re-listed under the support/ally bucket — is not a real game quantity. The correct content of a support-side resistance-reduction bucket in the cleaver_bloodsong_roster scenario is: Bloodsong contributes NO armor_reduction_percent [S2], and Carve is already accounted for exactly once elsewhere [S1, S9]. The leaf's correct value is ABSENT.

residual_uncertainty: The exported evidence tree contains data/ and docs/math-foundations.md only; the golden tree, the scenario roster definition and the sibling entries support_resistance_reduction[0..1] are in scripts/ and src/, which this runbook forbids reading. The sibling identities were therefore inferred, not observed.

The single world in which the OLD value would be correct: the ally is the sole Black Cleaver holder in the roster, does deal physical damage in the modeled window (Bloodsong's Spellblade is physical [S2], so this is possible), and no attacker-side Carve term exists to compose with. Nothing in the cached data supports two independently-composing Carve terms, and the scenario id names the cleaver as a fight-defining item — so under any reading where a Carve term survives elsewhere, the duplicate/mis-attributed support-bucket copy must go.

Every other candidate justification for the removal also lands on 'absent' being correct: expired 6 s stack window [S1], no physical damage from the ally at that event [S1], or non-physical damage event.
